title: Repo, build, CSP shell, gate runner, CI
goal: An empty but complete toolchain: dist/blank.html (valid, CSP-locked, self-contained shell) is built from src/ with Node built-ins only, type-checked, unit-tested, gated and checked in CI. Every later piece builds and is judged on this.
scope: Layout: src/ (engine modules with JSDoc), src/template.html, tools/{build,minify,lint,size,gates,serve}.mjs, test/unit (node --test), test/e2e (Playwright), bench/ (oracles, fixtures, stubs), docs/{SPEC.md stub, adr/, plan/}
package.json ("type":"module", engines node >=20, scripts build/test/gates/hooks); devDependencies pinned exactly: typescript, @playwright/test, axe-core
jsconfig.json: checkJs, strict, noEmit, target ES2022, lib DOM + ES2023

tools/build.mjs: fixed module order, strips module syntax, wraps in one IIFE, minifies, computes sha256 of the inline script and style (node:crypto), injects CSP meta → dist/blank.html; unminified twin dist/blank.dev.html with its own hashes
tools/minify.mjs: tokenizer-based (strings, template literals with nested ${}, regex vs division, comments), removes comments/whitespace only, never renames, emits "<\/script" inside strings
tools/lint.mjs: forbids innerHTML/outerHTML assignment, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval, new Function, string timers, TODO/FIXME, http(s) URLs in src/
tools/size.mjs: bytes of dist/blank.html vs ceiling_kb of the given piece; appends a row to docs/plan/size-log.md
tools/gates.mjs: runs G1–G12 as far as available, prints a table green/red/not-checked/n.a., exit ≠ 0 on any red or not-checked relevant gate; --piece selects ceilings and relevant gates
tools/serve.mjs: static server on localhost (node:http) for dist/ and bench/
CI (GitHub Actions, ubuntu-latest): npm ci, playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit, gates G1–G5, G7–G9, G11; mobile gates run locally only (README)
tools/hooks/commit-msg + npm run hooks: rejects Co-Authored-By and "Generated with" lines; same check in CI for PR commits

rules.rule: Zero runtime dependencies: dist/blank.html contains only code written in this repo.
No bundler or minifier packages; tools/ uses Node built-ins only.
CSP meta: default-src 'none'; script-src 'sha256-…'; style-src 'sha256-…'; img-src data: blob:
Every browser test runs against the minified dist and the dev twin.
Conventional Commits in English, no AI trailers.

bar.primary: Metric (non-visual piece): reproducible build, working gate runner, green CI

criteria: npm ci && npm run build produces dist/blank.html and dist/blank.dev.html; a second build is byte-identical (cmp).
dist/blank.html opens on file:// in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with 0 console errors, 0 securitypolicyviolation events and 0 network requests (Playwright listeners).
The CSP hashes in the meta tag equal sha256 of the inline script and style (test recomputes); changing one byte of the script makes the browser block it (test).

test/unit/minify.test.js covers regex vs division, nested template literals, comment-like strings, "</script>" inside strings, ASI-sensitive returns; minified output evaluates identically to the source for every case (node:vm).
tools/lint.mjs fails on a fixture containing el.innerHTML = x and passes on src/.
npx tsc -p jsconfig.json reports 0 errors in strict mode.
gates.mjs prints the G1–G12 table and exits ≠ 0 when a relevant gate is red or not-checked (deliberately failing fixture).
size.mjs fails when the ceiling is exceeded (test with a 1-byte ceiling).
The commit-msg hook rejects a test commit containing "Co-Authored-By:" (temp repo).
CI runs on push and PR; gh run list shows a green run on the branch.
acceptance.critic: No blind comparison (infrastructure). The critic clones fresh into a temp dir, runs npm ci, build and gates itself and checks every criterion; the gap is the first criterion without evidence.

decision_note: dist/ is gitignored; release artifacts are attached to tags (E1-017). Node 20 is on PATH and sufficient.
